notes.title: Demo 1.0.2 Now Available
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the demo of our game is now available publicly.

Some of you may have already played previous demo version so the patch notes include:
- Optimized assets reducing the game size and loading times.
- Interactive Programming Tutorial.
- Other minor bug fixes.

The biggest addition here is of course the programming tutorial. The SLangIDE (our programming application) will now have a dedicated button to help you learn our custom language and make programs with it. With this, we covered some lacking content we wanted to show in the demo but that's not the end!

Coming Soon:
- An expansion of programming tutorial with 3D scenes to allow not only to operate on the PC, but also on surrounding devices.
- An example hacking mission where you'll be able to prepare for and perform a field hack of a powerful businessman which will put your knowledge to the test and showcase a broader range of our hacking mechanics.
